extracted_clauses.text: This policy is applicable to all employees of the company who are required to undertake business travel within India. Applicability is limited to official business travel.

Travel is classified as a 'Tour' if the duration is between 1 to 15 days (inclusive). 'Deputation' is defined as travel lasting 15 days to 1 year. 'Transfer' is defined as travel exceeding 1 year in duration.

Lodging & Boarding allowances will be payable to employees for tours within India, as per the limits specified in Table 4. Amounts are maximum permissible rates upon submission of actual bills and are exclusive of taxes.
Directors, CEO, COO, and Presidents (Grade M1) are entitled to Air (Economy) / Train (AC I, II) / Taxi (AC) for inter-city travel and Taxi (AC) for local travel.

VP, AVP, GM, DGM, and RM (Grade M2) are entitled to Air (Economy) / Train (AC I, II) / Taxi (AC) for inter-city travel and Taxi (AC) for local travel. Taxi (AC) includes hatchback/sedan cars; Sedan/SUV cars can be booked when traveling with clients.

AGM, Sr. Manager, Sr. BM, RSM, Manager, Deputy Manager, Assistant Manager, Sr. Executive, Sr. Engineer, ASM, and BM (Grade M3) are entitled to Train (III AC) / Bus / Taxi (AC) for inter-city travel and Taxi (AC) for local travel.

extracted_clauses.text: M4 grade employees are entitled to Train (III AC) / Bus / Taxi (AC) for inter-city travel and Auto, Taxi (Non-AC) for local travel.

M5/M6 grade employees are entitled to Train & Bus (Sleeper) / Shared Taxi / Auto for inter-city travel and Auto, Taxi (Non-AC) for local travel. Local travel via Auto is limited to <10 KM; >10 KM requires Public/Shared Transport.
Auto/Taxi Non-AC fares are Rs. 8/KM. Taxi AC fares are Rs. 10/KM.

Lodging allowances for Grade M1 employees in Category A cities are Rs. 4000, and in Category B cities are Rs. 3000. Boarding allowance is Actual for both categories, with a personal incidental allowance of Actual up to Rs. 150.

Lodging allowances for Grade M2 employees in Category A cities are Rs. 3000, and in Category B cities are Rs. 2000. Boarding allowance is Actual for both categories, with a personal incidental allowance of Actual up to Rs. 125.

Lodging allowances for Grade M3 employees in Category A cities are Rs. 3000, and in Category B cities are Rs. 2000. Boarding allowance is Actual for both categories, with a personal incidental allowance of Actual up to Rs. 100.

Lodging allowances for Grade M4 employees in Category A cities are Rs. 2000, and in Category B cities are Rs. 1500. Boarding allowance is Actual for both categories, with a personal incidental allowance of Actual up to Rs. 75.

Lodging allowances for Grade M5 employees in Category A cities are Rs. 2000, and in Category B cities are Rs. 1500. Boarding allowance is Actual for both categories, with a personal incidental allowance of Actual up to Rs. 50.

Lodging allowances for Grade M6 employees in Category A cities are Rs. 1000, and in Category B cities are Rs. 700. Boarding allowance is Actual for both categories, with a personal incidental allowance of Actual up to Rs. 50.
If an employee stays at a relative’s or friend’s place during an official tour, they will be given Rs. 250 per day as lodging reimbursement.
Employees are entitled to claim Rs. 7.0 per KM for Four Wheeler usage and Rs. 2.5 per KM for Two Wheeler usage for official work.
Entitlement calculation is based on a 24-hour clock. For durations of 3 to 12 hours, 50% of the daily allowance is payable. For durations of 12 to 24 hours, 100% of the daily allowance is payable.
IF travel duration is between 3 to 12 hours, THEN employee is entitled to 50% of their daily allowance.
IF travel duration is between 12 to 24 hours, THEN employee is entitled to 100% of their daily allowance.
All expense claims (except Boarding and Personal incidental category) MUST be supported by bills/invoices.
IF a travel duration is greater than 15 days but less than 1 year at one location, THEN it will be treated as deputation.
During deputation, for 1-7 days of travel, benefits are as per the tour policy.
IF deputation duration exceeds 7 days, THEN allowances will be provided as per Table 7, based on employee Grade and Category.
IF the company provides guest house and food facilities at the deputation site, THEN the employee is NOT entitled to any of the deputation allowances.
Employees do NOT require to submit bills for deputation entitlements.
IF an employee is shifted to a location with a duration projection of more than 1 year, THEN it will be treated as a transfer.
For relocation/transfer, the distance between two places MUST be greater than 100 KM for reimbursement eligibility.
During the initial 7 days of relocation/transfer, entitlements are as per the tour policy.
For Grade M1 employees, lodging allowance is Actual, boarding allowance is Actual, and travel allowance is Actual.
For Grade M2 employees, lodging allowance is 4000, boarding allowance is 350, and travel allowance is 150.
For Grade M2B employees, lodging allowance is 3000, boarding allowance is 250, and travel allowance is 125.
For Grades M3 to M6, lodging allowance is 2000, boarding allowance is 150, and travel allowance is 100.
The amount limits mentioned in Table 4 are maximum permissible rates upon submission of actual bills and are exclusive of taxes.
All expense claims MUST be supported by bills/invoices.
For relocation expenses towards shifting of household goods, the employee MUST provide 3 quotations, and HR will verify and approve one.
The maximum limit for relocation expenses towards shifting of household goods is 20,000.
For Grade M1/M2, the mode of travel is Air (Economy).
For Grade M2B, the mode of travel is Train (AC II) /Taxi (AC) at 10 Rs/KM.
For Grade M3, the mode of travel is Train (III AC) /Bus/Taxi(AC) at 10 Rs/KM.
For Grade M4, the mode of travel is Train (III AC)/Bus(AC) /Shared Taxi/Auto.
For Grades M5/M6, the mode of travel is Train & Bus (Sleeper)/Shared Taxi/ Auto/ Public Conveyance.
IF a particular class of ticket is unavailable, THEN a ticket one class down will be booked.

Employees MUST send a request mail for booking a ticket to reservation@ujaas.com. The request MUST be made 1 day prior to the date of travel. The travel desk will ask for travel approval via email from the supervisor/HOD before booking.

Employees are NOT allowed to book tickets directly unless in an emergency. IF an employee books directly from a Vendor, they MUST obtain permission from their HOD for company payment. Direct bookings require submission of the ticket and debit/credit card statement.

Request mails for booking MUST include employee name, age, designation, contact number, project code, tour purpose, place, duration, DOT, and HOD approval (or reason for absence). Eligibility for return booking needs to be mentioned.
IF an employee requests a specific flight/Train or Bus, they MUST state the reason for choosing it in the request mail.
Employees MUST send their ticket booking request at least one day before the date of journey. IF a request is made within one day (urgent booking), the reason for urgency MUST be stated.
Employees are NOT allowed to request special Hotels/ Flights/ Seats/ Web Check-in.

Employees MUST submit bills within 15 days of completing their tour. IF bills are not submitted within this timeframe, a reason MUST be attached. Bills not submitted against tour advances for more than 30 days will be deducted from the next month’s salary.
Bill submission information MUST include employee name, tour code, designation, department, tour date, and bill amount, and date of submission.
The bill MUST have the signature of the employee and their HOD.
IF there is any deviation in the amounts on the bill, HOD approval with a clarification note is REQUIRED.
IF an employee pays bills themselves, they MUST submit the bill and their credit/debit card statement (for card payments).
It is the employee’s RESPONSIBILITY to obtain authentic bills.
When submitting a bill for auto or taxi, employees MUST mention the names of the places and the distance traveled for smooth processing.
